thesis: Gold trades quietly through Asia and reprices when London and then New York liquidity arrives. The first 15-minute close outside the Asian range (00:00-07:00 UTC) before noon UTC tends to carry; stop on the far side of the range, 2R target, flat by the end of the New York morning. The classic gold day trade.
risks: False breaks on quiet days; news spikes (US data at 12:30 UTC) can reverse the move; the edge is widely known, so it may be arbitraged thin.
